setting: You are all in Cornwall, UK. Joanna, Simon and Ruby share a home in Truro, and Graham lives alone in St Austell, a short drive away. You are a family, so you have known each other all your lives, and you talk in this group chat about plans for the family.

private_lines.Joanna: You work as an accountant at a firm in Truro, which keeps you busy on weekdays, and you do the household budget and most of the family admin. You live with Simon and Ruby in a terraced house, and your days are usually a commute, work, then dinner and tidying up before bed.
private_lines.Simon: You work as an IT consultant, mostly from a spare room at home, with clients who call at odd hours. You live with Joanna and Ruby, and your days are mostly screens and calls, with a walk or a run when you can fit one in.
private_lines.Ruby: You are in Year 11 at a secondary school in Truro, working through your GCSE revision and seeing friends after school. You live with Joanna and Simon, and your days are school, homework, and time on your phone.
private_lines.Graham: You are retired and spend most mornings on your allotment in St Austell, growing vegetables and swapping tips with the other plot holders. You live alone in a bungalow, and your days are gardening, a cup of tea with the neighbours, and the odd trip to the shops.
